entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Are the demands still coming in?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes. Lately I've been getting[n]calls from men I don't even know.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It seems they changed their[n]strategy, surely according to[n]Kaneshiro's orders.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Are you going to be OK?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I am. I can't say it feels[n]particularly great though.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But as long as he considers[n]me a valuable commodity...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I believe he won't do[n]anything too rash.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We cannot be entirely sure[n]of that fact though.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Who knows when he may decide[n]to turn to violence?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I fully expect that will happen[n]once the deadline has passed.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Then again, who knows if[n]he's even gonna keep his[n]promise in the first place.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, we gotta take care of[n]him before shit hits the fan!
